verdict.rationale: An official-looking MCP server repo (mcp-server-raygun) exists under Raygun's parent org MindscapeHQ, confirming the capability exists, but there is no first-party documentation page, setup guide, or independent corroboration detailing its use. Missing for 10: official Raygun-branded docs describing MCP setup/capabilities, independent hands-on validation, and detail on what tools/actions the server exposes.
